## Notes

- Commonwealth (printed 34.86, jp2 141; Commonwealth Charts.pdf p. 31), Italian (34.89a) and German (34.89b, jp2 177; Axis Charts.pdf p. 35) Pilot Arrival Tables, each read twice from the archive.org scan and the community chart PDFs: 0 of 132 cells differ. The rules call the Commonwealth table 34.88.
- Two dice, added, once a month per nation in the first Operations Stage's naval convoy arrival phase; pilots lists how many pilots of rating 1, 2, 3 and 4 arrive (no table gives a 5). Commonwealth and Italian: November 1940 to October 1942; German: March 1941 to October 1942.
- Marseille, rating 6, joins the Germans in any Operations Stage of Game-Turn 29, without a roll.
